description:
Purrr! Prepare for a delightful mission in a fantasy landscape – many cats can be found across this magical realm…

Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be discovered – over 350 of them, to be somewhat precise…

Pick your favourite colours for your game’s look and feel, and keep your eyes peeled for any balls of joy that wait to be pet!~
name: Hidden Kittens: Kingdom of Cats
intro: A fantasy medieval adventure… with cute cats scattered around!
